agentInbox.changeFailed: Could not update client access. Check the app recovery status.
agentInbox.toggleFailed: Could not change the inbox status. Restart the app.
agentInbox.starting: Checking saved data and recovery status
agentInbox.busy: Another app process is handling requests
agentInbox.unavailable: The inbox could not be started. Check the recovery status and restart the app.
agentInbox.title: Authenticated AI requests
agentInbox.description: Registered AI clients can view saved work, review plans and request generation through the existing queue under your execution policy. Cancellation and registration recovery for saved results require human approval. Requests are processed while the app is running.
agentInbox.registrationScope: Registration identifies the client. Generation queue requests are separately controlled by your execution policy and approvals.
agentInbox.keyStorage: Secret keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager. Copy the connection details for your external submission tool. After rotating a key, use the updated connection details.
agentInbox.copied: Connection details copied without secret keys.
agentInbox.copyFailed: Could not copy the connection details.
agentInbox.policyExplanation: Automatic execution requires an explicit expiry and stays within these limits. Pausing or expiry requires human review again.
agentInbox.unavailableChanges: Cancellation and result registration recovery require human approval even in automatic mode. Folder changes and storage uploads are currently unavailable. Overwriting files and deleting originals are never allowed by this policy.
agentInbox.policySaveFailed: Could not save the policy. Review the current revision, limits and expiry. Execution stays paused after a storage failure.
agentInbox.outputLocalR2: Save local images and upload to R2
agentInbox.approvalFailed: Could not apply the decision. The plan, policy or expiry may have changed. Review the refreshed request.
agentInbox.cancelEffect: Stop the batch's remaining jobs and active requests. Existing results and records of uncertain requests are preserved. Cancellation does not guarantee that charges for dispatched generation are reversed.
agentInbox.storageEffect: Finish registering the already saved image and mark this job complete. This does not regenerate the image or upload it to R2.
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_STORAGE_TARGET_CHANGED: The storage recovery target changed and needs another review
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_STORAGE_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The saved result to recover could not be verified
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_CANCEL_TARGET_CHANGED: The jobs to stop have changed and need another review
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_CANCEL_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The jobs to stop could not be verified
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_OUTSTANDING_LIMIT: Too many unfinished requests for this client
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_REPLAN_REQUIRED: Create a new plan within its budget
agentInbox.reason_AGENT_PLAN_STALE: Source or output settings changed; create a new plan
agentInbox.reason_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Client access is no longer valid
